Supply externally estimated cohort coefficients

Source: R/external_input.R
cohort_input.Rd

Construct the common input object from externally estimated quantities. The pre-treatment coefficients must be the paper's fixed-initial-control block-bias estimates with the stated normalization. Ordinary imputation residuals and an aggregated event study are not sufficient substitutes.

Usage

cohort_input(
  betahat,
  vcov,
  coefficient_info,
  W,
  normalization,
  cohort_sizes,
  estimator = "imp",
  diagnostics = list()
)

Arguments

betahat

Named numeric vector of cohort-period coefficients, including pre-treatment and reference-period coefficients.

vcov

Their joint sampling covariance, with matching row/column names. It is used as supplied: the covariance option of cohort_fit() does not apply here, and printed results describe it as supplied to cohort_input(). To use a CR2 covariance, compute it and pass it here.

coefficient_info

Data frame with coordinate, cohort (integer adoption index), relative_period (one at adoption), and type ("pre"/"post"). Rows identify the supplied coefficient names.

W

Square bias map with matching coordinate names: delta = W Delta.

normalization

Matrix of deterministic coefficient constraints, with named columns. For CS this selects the zero reference coefficients; for imputation it encodes mean-zero pre-treatment coefficients.

cohort_sizes

Named positive sizes or fixed masses, one per cohort.

estimator

Estimator label: "imp", "cs_nyt", or "cs_nt".

diagnostics

Optional list describing covariance provenance and sample.

Value

A cohort_fit object accepted by cohort_sensitivity().
